objective: Add an isolated M2193 ordinary/TSBG selective-bank cache-fill candidate that computes the exact union of the four loaded B4 contexts, treats a cache hit as coverage of the needed per-bank mask, requests only missing banks through the unchanged M803 protocol, merges the refill, and preserves private typed-signed Acc24 arithmetic and commit identity.

upstream_identity.m2184_authority_boundary: RTL consideration only; no RTL, component-speedup, system-speedup, PPA, energy, or paper claim was admitted.

mechanism_contract.needed_mask: For the current source group, low and high eight-bank masks are the exact bitwise union of active_row over all four loaded B4 contexts.
mechanism_contract.cache_validity: Each cache line carries a tag plus an eight-bit valid mask per half; a bank becomes valid only after all six output slices of that bank refill have returned.
mechanism_contract.partial_hit_definition: tag_match && at least one needed bank is invalid
mechanism_contract.refill_definition: missing_mask = needed_mask & ~valid_mask; only missing_mask is issued; returned banks are merged into the resident line.
mechanism_contract.zero_needed_behavior: A zero descriptor does not become a live row. A source group whose four descriptors are all zero generates no fetch, bridge issue, or accumulator update.
mechanism_contract.eviction_policy: Existing invalid-first/LRU policy is retained; a tag miss clears both per-half bank-valid masks before refill.
mechanism_contract.ordinary_tsbg_fairness: SCHEDULE_MODE=0 and SCHEDULE_MODE=1 expose identical public ports, B4 load contract, cache capacity, selective-bank interface, private accumulators, and directed workload. Only static row ordering differs.
private_state: source sign and typed signed source value

required_cases: tag partial hit and missing-bank-only refill
negative source including INT8 -128 exact nine-bit negation

execution_chain.m2193: source authoring, static selftest, contract, and author receipt only
execution_chain.m2194: independent exhaustive source hammer and sole authority decision
execution_chain.m2195: one license query, one VCS compile, and one simv run only after an admitted M2194 seal
execution_chain.m2196: independent raw-result hammer before any verification claim

red_lines: Do not modify M2018, M803, or docs/359.
Do not run VCS, simv, any EDA tool, lmutil, or GPU work before M2194 independently admits the exact sealed sources.
Do not weaken exact B4 union, needed-mask coverage, missing-bank-only request, response merge, or popcount source_count semantics.
Do not give ordinary and TSBG different public ports, cache capacity, selective-bank ability, or directed workload.
Do not share source sign, destination, tag, terminal, product, or Acc24 state across contexts.
M2195 has no retry and M2196 is required before any directed-VCS claim.
No source-only, CPU-model, or future VCS result may be promoted to speedup, PPA, energy, or paper evidence.
